content.short: Coin Wallet is a non-custodial, multi-currency wallet providing a simple interface for TON and other crypto.
content.description: Coin Wallet is a long-standing non-custodial, multi-currency wallet that provides users with complete control over their private keys. It offers a simple and secure interface for sending, receiving, and exchanging a wide range of cryptocurrencies, including Toncoin (TON). Coin Wallet focuses on accessibility and user sovereignty, making it an excellent choice for both beginners and experienced users who want a reliable and straightforward way to manage their digital assets across different blockchain networks in a single, secure application.
content.meta: Control your crypto with Coin Wallet. Simple and secure multi-currency wallet on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
